content: CI reproducibility check for derived committed files: run generators, then git diff --exit-code on the tree; any diff = stale artifacts = build failure showing the diff. Companions: git ls-files --error-unmatch to ensure goldens are tracked; --update-golden/--check mode split (write by default, verify in --check); gated auto-update commits only from CI with explicit tags. See golden-file digest for the full recipe.
